Rathore   "I  have  been  employed  at  Palm  Residency  for  6  years.  On  14/10/2024,  I  was  on  duty  at  Gate  No.  1  from   16:00  to  00:00  hrs.  At  about  17:30  hrs,  Dr.  Aniruddh  Sen  arrived  home  alone  in  his  car.  At  around  20:15  
hrs,
 
 I  saw  the  cook,  Rakesh,  walk  through  the  pedestrian  exit.  He  carried  a  bulky  black  nylon  backpack.   Usually  he  leaves  around  21:30  hrs  after  serving  dinner.  When  I  asked  him  why  he  was  leaving  early,  he   appeared  agitated  and  said  'Bhaiya  (Dr.  Sen)  told  me  to  pick  up  groceries  from  Munirka  market'.  He  
avoided
 
 eye  contact  and  walked  rapidly  toward  the  main  road  auto  stand.  At  22:10  hrs,  Dr.  Shalini  Sen  arrived  and   within  five  minutes  called  the  intercom  in  distress."   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------   STATEMENT  OF  WITNESS  2  (PW-4)  Name:  Manoj  Kumar  |  Age:  34  yrs  |  Occupation:  Auto-Rickshaw  Driver  (DL-1RA-4491)  Recorded  on:  16/10/2024  at  16:00  IST  by  SI  Ramesh  Rawat   "On  the  night  of  14/10/2024  at  approximately  20:25  IST,  I  was  waiting  near  the  bus  stop  outside  Palm   Residency.  A  young  male  matching  the  suspect's  photograph,  carrying  a  heavy  black  backpack,  
approached
 
in
 
 haste.  He  offered  me  Rs.  500  (against  the  standard  Rs.  180  fare)  to  rush  him  straight  to  New  Delhi  
Railway
 
 Station  without  stopping.  During  transit,  he  made  two  telephone  calls.  I  heard  him  say:  'Kaam  ho  gaya  
hai,
 
 main  Gorakhdham  pakad  raha  hoon,  subah  tak  Gorakhpur  pahuchunga'  (The  job  is  done,  I  am  catching  
the
 
 Gorakhdham  Express,  will  reach  Gorakhpur  by  morning).  He  alighted  at  Paharganj  side  station  gate  at  
21:10
 
IST."

DEPARTMENT  OF  FORENSIC  MEDICINE  &  TOXICOLOGY  ALL  INDIA  INSTITUTE  OF  MEDICAL  SCIENCES  (AIIMS),  NEW  DELHI   PM  No.:  1104/FM/2024                                          Date  &  Time:  15/10/2024,  10:30  IST  Deceased:  Dr.  Aniruddh  Sen  |  Age:  44  yrs  |  Male               Identified  by:  Const.  Pradeep  (No.  441/SW)   EXTERNAL  INJURIES:  1.  Incised  stab  wound:  3.8  cm  x  1.2  cm  x  muscle  deep  over  the  left  anterolateral  aspect  of  neck,      positioned  5  cm  below  the  angle  of  the  left  mandible.  Edges  are  clean  cut.  Lower  angle  is  acute,      upper  angle  is  blunt,  corresponding  to  a  single-edged  weapon.  Left  common  carotid  artery  severed.  2.  Contusion  with  laceration:  6.0  cm  x  2.5  cm  over  the  right  parietal  prominence  of  the  scalp,      margins  ragged  with  surrounding  tissue  bridging.  3.  Defensive  Wounds:  Linear  incised  cuts  measuring  2.0  cm  and  1.5  cm  across  the  palmar  aspect  of      the  right  index  and  middle  fingers.   INTERNAL  EXAMINATION:  -  Head:  Extravasation  of  blood  in  scalp  tissue  corresponding  to  injury  #2.  Linear  fissure  fracture     (4.5  cm)  on  right  parietal  bone.  Subdural  hematoma  (~40  ml).  -  Neck:  Massive  hemorrhage  tracking  into  fascial  planes.  Trachea  pale,  lumen  empty.  -  Stomach:  Contains  approx.  150  ml  of  semi-digested  food  material  resembling  lentils  and  rice;     no  anomalous  odor.  Gastric  emptying  time  suggests  food  consumed  2  to  3  hours  prior  to  death.   OPINION  AS  TO  CAUSE  AND  TIME  OF  DEATH:  -  Cause  of  Death:  Hemorrhagic  shock  secondary  to  transection  of  major  cervical  vessels  (left  common     carotid  artery)  produced  by  a  sharp,  cutting  weapon  (Injury  #1),  compounded  by  blunt  force  head  
trauma.
 -  Time  Since  Death:  Approximately  14  to  16  hours  prior  to  post-mortem  examination  (placing  time  of     death  between  20:30  IST  and  21:00  IST  on  14/10/2024).   Autopsy  Surgeon:  [Sd/-  Dr.  P.K.  Nambiar,  MD  (Forensic  Medicine)]  Reg.  No.:  DMC-48291
